about_the_game:
Join the young Leshen, Iona, on a breathtaking floating island nestled upon the ancient shell of Heimsskjald, the colossal sea turtle! This once-lively land, teeming with unique inhabitants, now calls for Iona’s magical abilities to transform it back into the paradise oasis it was destined to be.

The time has come again for the spirit island to be reborn. As Iona, you awaken to find your island home in disarray. Your help is needed to cleanse the land, rekindle its vibrant life, and repopulate it with a community of whimsical beings.

Master Ancient Magic - relearn and expand Iona’s repertoire of magical abilities. You’ll learn spells as you unlock this island’s mysteries to help you grow, shrink, and mold the island with your mind’s eye. Your growing power is key to the island's restoration.

Nurture and Customize Your Island. Actively shape the environment. With Iona’s ancient magic, you’ll be able to populate the island with all sorts of flora, useful stones and even touch the stars. Your creativity directly impacts the island's beauty and appeal.

Befriend a Fantastical Cast: Meet and interact with a diverse array of unique island residents. Each resident has their own personality, story and quests that need your help to restore their part of the island.

Explore and Uncover Secrets: Traverse the varied landscapes of Heimsskjald's back. You’ll uncover hidden caves, creatures brave and timid, mystical mermaids and uncover remnants of old.

Restore Global Balance: Your whimsical efforts contribute to restoring harmony in the world. Witness the tangible effects of your actions as the island transforms from desolate to dazzling in this cozy sandbox style adventure.

Journey to the Spirit Realm: Go beyond the humble island roots and touch the spirit realm... You’ll be able to go beyond the Island wonders and touch the stars through the will of Heimsskjald.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or later
  • Processor: 3.0 GHz processor
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GT 740 (2048 MB) or equivalent | Radeon HD 5770 (1024 MB)
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or later
  • Processor: 3.5 GHz processor
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 460 (1024 MB) or equivalent | Radeon HD 7770 (1024 MB
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

short_description: Restore a vibrant island paradise atop a giant sea turtle! As the Leshen Iona, wield ancient spells to heal the land and befriend islanders and help them with their quests. Create your own enchanting sandbox style sanctuary. Uncover secrets and reshape a world with accompanied by cozy, lofi vibes.
